question: X is the mother-in-law of Y and Z. P is the daughter of N who is the husband of Z. How is N related to X?
solution:
Family chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bab004ac719d3665ce6e0880a0be369a09b241999e85d748dbb6c25ac87a9d1.png] 

Given:

X is the mother-in-law of Y and Z. This means Y and Z are married to X's children.

P is the daughter of N who is the husband of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/257fd50522f7945aa0249fb9735df126ffcda1bbdd7b8224c4c28ec27b4045ea.png] 

So, N is the **'Son' **of X.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
